title: Receiving Breakthrough Through Stillness and Trust in God
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he unlocks the powerful message of "Be Still and Know That I Am God" from Psalm 46:10. In this sermon, Pastor Chris reveals the four essential "knowings" you need to experience breakthrough and trust in God's presence and power, even in the midst of chaos and uncertainty. Get ready to be encouraged, equipped, and empowered to trust God and see Him work miracles in your life.
